about: EXPORT-1 — the premium effects routing table. A card listed under routes plays its additive effect clip, drawn on the game's own beats (the beat code stays the conductor; the clip only draws). Remove a card's entry and it returns to its classic sprite by a data edit, no revert. A clip that is not ready, or fails, at its moment draws the classic sprite instead (owner ruling EXPORT-1/7: fail-open falls back to yesterday's game, never to absence).

pinned.brahmastra: sprBrahmastra stays exactly as-is until the owner's rebuilt clip re-runs the template
pinned.meghnad: the lab's pilot and reference; his live presentation stays exactly as-is
